$comment: Computed-style fingerprint of the rendered homepage, captured from a real browser against the UK store. Keyed by PAINTED font — the first family in each computed stack, which is what the browser actually draws when the webfont loads. Recapture with the snippet in scripts/README-style-check.md.
notes: 430 signatures before and after the token migration — the page structure did not move.
Arial paints on 29 signatures and must stay Arial.

Assistant is Shopify's font_picker output and paints the majority of the page. It is NOT a brand font. Deliberately left alone; it now resolves through --font-theme-body so changing it later is one edit rather than a hunt. Tracked in TODO.md.

PPMori SemiBold, PPEditorial New Ultrabold and PPEditorialNew Ultralight are named in CSS but have NO @font-face anywhere, so they silently fall back today. Left as-is, since loading them would change rendering. Tracked in TODO.md.

Methodology: the authoritative before/after proof is `npm run fonts:check -- --painted`, which diffs declarations. This census corroborates at the cascade level and is the baseline for future comparisons.
